vocab.example: Your salary adjustment will be reflected in next month's payslip.

vocab.example_vi: Lương sau thuế của tôi khoảng mười tám triệu đồng.

listening.title: Reviewing Salary and Benefits with HR

lines.speaker: Lan (HR)
lines.text: Minh, let's go through your benefits package for this year.

lines.speaker: Minh (Employee)
lines.text: Great, I have a few questions about my salary too.

lines.speaker: Lan (HR)
lines.text: Sure. First, do you know the difference between before-tax salary and after-tax salary?

lines.speaker: Minh (Employee)
lines.text: I think before-tax salary is the amount before deductions, and after-tax salary is what I actually receive.

lines.speaker: Lan (HR)
lines.text: Exactly. Now, about the salary adjustment — it will take effect from next month.

lines.speaker: Minh (Employee)
lines.text: That's good news. When does the payroll cycle usually run?

lines.speaker: Lan (HR)
lines.text: Our payroll cycle runs from the first to the last day of each month.

lines.speaker: Minh (Employee)
lines.text: Got it. Do we still get a performance-based bonus this year?

lines.speaker: Lan (HR)
lines.text: Yes, and if you work extra hours on a project, you'll also get overtime pay.

lines.speaker: Minh (Employee)
lines.text: One more thing — does the benefits package include a housing allowance?

lines.speaker: Lan (HR)
lines.text: Yes, a housing allowance is included for staff based outside the city.
